extension_trigger.reason: All otherwise available rank-8-through-rank-20 candidates either failed a frozen gate, are already selected, are permanently rejected for invalid memory-generation chronology, or would exceed the frozen category cap.

outcome_blindness.rule: No prior or current model outcome may select a candidate, define or tune p*, edit a memory, weaken an oracle or witness, or decide a reference implementation.

ordered_extension.backup_rule: Only after Family 6 is fixed may review continue in original rank order to identify at most one additional backup.
ordered_extension.parallel_review_policy: Evidence review may run in parallel, but decisions are reconciled strictly in original rank order and no higher-ranked candidate may supersede an unresolved eligible lower-ranked candidate.
ordered_extension.ranking_policy: Continue from rank 21 in the original deterministic ranking. Do not retrieve a new universe, redesign retrieval, or rerank candidates.
ordered_extension.rejection_policy: Preserve every inspected candidate and its first pre-outcome rejection reason. A Gate-B rejection is permanent and cannot be revived.
ordered_extension.selection_rule: The first candidate in original rank order satisfying every pipeline requirement and an available frozen category slot becomes Family 6.
